# Software Mansion open source documentation

> Documentation for the libraries and tools built and maintained by Software Mansion (https://swmansion.com).

Each project below is a separate documentation site served from this domain. Where a project publishes its own llms.txt, it sits at <project path>/llms.txt.

## React Native

- [React Native Reanimated](https://docs.swmansion.com/react-native-reanimated/): A powerful animation library that makes it easy to create smooth animations and interactions that run in the UI thread.
- [React Native Gesture Handler](https://docs.swmansion.com/react-native-gesture-handler/): Declarative API exposing platform native touch and gesture system to React Native.
- [React Native Screens](https://docs.swmansion.com/react-native-screens/): Native Navigation primitives for your React Native app.
- [React Native Audio API](https://docs.swmansion.com/react-native-audio-api/): React Native Audio API is a library that lets you build powerful audio features in your app – from real-time effects and visualization to multi-track playback
- [React Native Enriched HTML](https://docs.swmansion.com/react-native-enriched-html/)
- [React Native WHIP/WHEP](https://docs.swmansion.com/react-native-whip-whep/): Documentation for react-native-whip-whep
- [npx setup-ci](https://docs.swmansion.com/setup-ci/): Quickly bootstrap CI for your React Native app

## Cairo and Starknet

- [Scarb](https://docs.swmansion.com/scarb/): Scarb is a build toolchain and package manager for Cairo and Starknet ecosystems.
- [Cairo Language Server](https://docs.swmansion.com/cairols/): Cairo Language Server is an implementation of Language Server Protocol for the Cairo language.
- [Cairo lint](https://docs.swmansion.com/cairo-lint/): Cairo lint is a static code analyzer tool for Cairo language.
- [Cairo Debugger](https://docs.swmansion.com/cairo-debugger/): Cairo Debugger is an implementation of Debug Adapter Protocol for the Cairo language.
- [Protostar](https://docs.swmansion.com/protostar/): Protostar manages your dependencies, compiles your project, and runs test.
- [starknet-jvm](https://docs.swmansion.com/starknet-jvm/)
- [starknet.swift](https://docs.swmansion.com/starknet.swift/)

## Elixir

- [LiveDebugger](https://docs.swmansion.com/live-debugger/): A must-have tool for Elixir developers. See your LiveComponents tree, inspect assigns, trace and filter callback executions, and more.

## Kotlin Multiplatform

- [KMP Maps](https://docs.swmansion.com/kmp-maps/)
- [KMP Sharing](https://docs.swmansion.com/kmp-sharing/)

## Apple platforms

- [Pulsar](https://docs.swmansion.com/pulsar/): Pulsar is an open-source library that offers ready-to-use haptic presets. With it, you can add haptics to your Kotlin, Swift, or React Native app in minutes.

## Web and GPU

- [TypeGPU](https://docs.swmansion.com/TypeGPU/)
- [byegl](https://docs.swmansion.com/byegl/)
- [tsover](https://docs.swmansion.com/tsover/)

## Other

- [Ma’at](https://docs.swmansion.com/maat/)
